signature.name: VTask.lift
signature.type: {R : Type u} -> {S : Type v} -> [CommRing R] -> [Ring S] -> {f : Polynomial R} -> [Algebra R S] -> (h : IsAdjoinRoot S f) -> {T : Type u_1} -> [CommRing T] -> (i : R →+* T) -> (x : T) -> (hx : Polynomial.eval₂ i x f = 0) -> S →+* T

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The function is total on all valid inputs (any h, i, x, hx satisfying the stated types). There are no junk-value conventions because the domain is exactly the set of inputs satisfying the root condition hx, which is explicit in the type.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {S : Type*} [CommRing R] [Ring S] {f : Polynomial R} [Algebra R S] (h : IsAdjoinRoot S f) {T : Type*} [CommRing T] (i : R →+* T) (x : T) (hx : Polynomial.eval₂ i x f = 0), VTask.lift h i x hx h.root = x

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {S : Type*} [CommRing R] [Ring S] {f : Polynomial R} [Algebra R S] (h : IsAdjoinRoot S f) {T : Type*} [CommRing T] (i : R →+* T) (x : T) (hx : Polynomial.eval₂ i x f = 0) (g : S →+* T), (∀ a : R, g (algebraMap R S a) = i a) → g h.root = x → g = VTask.lift h i x hx
